title: Etale support and pullback functors
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $X$ be a scheme, and let $j:U\to X$ be an open immersion and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] [def-weil-closed-immersion]. On module sheaves on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], define the support kernel $\operatorname{SuppKer}_{A,j}=\ker(j^*\dashv j_*)$ using the unit $\mathrm{id}\to j_*j^*$, define the closed support functor $\operatorname{Supp}_{A,i,j}=i^*\circ\operatorname{SuppKer}_{A,j}$, and for every morphism $g:Y\to X$ define the derived inverse-image functor $g^*=(g^*)_{\mathrm{termwise}}:D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)\leftarrow D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ by the derived functor induced by the exact etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories].

source.place: Expose XVII, Lemma 7.6.10, p. 313: the kernel of the open restriction unit, its closed inverse image, and termwise inverse image on the etale module derived category.
